[RTCT.6.1] **Identity and framing.** `RealtimeContract` is field **128** of
`proto/atom.proto#Atom`'s `body` oneof, and that field number is its
wire identity ([RFCS.16.1], [RDSC.7.1]). Framing is
the container's, two levels, both protobuf ([RFCS.19.1]) — there is no
ASCII magic and no big-endian length. Its body is
a `RealtimeContract` protobuf message (see [RTCT.6.2]).
